card.name: First name after a byline
card.fires_on: The first name of an author right after "By" or "Reviewed by" in a news or article byline. It also fires weakly on source names in credit lines, such as NPR or NYU Press.

modes.label: Author first name
modes.description: A first name directly after "By" or "by" at the start of an article or review credit.
modes.example: Say Developing Countries Will Be Hit Hard By Water Scarcity in the 21st Century By<< Sharon>> Keeler UNH News Bureau

modes.label: Publisher or source credit
modes.description: Part of a publisher or outlet name in a copyright or source line.

card.plain: It marks the author's first name in a byline, just before the surname is expected.
